bio: Melissa Luburich Bean (née Luburich; born January 22, 1962) is an American politician who served as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 8th congressional district from 2005 to 2011. A member of the Democratic Party, Bean is set to return to her old seat after winning the 2026 U.S. House election.
